# Resolve friend contacts and approve their pending Venmo requests
phone_token = apis.phone.login(username=user.username, password=user.password)
friend_emails = set()
page = 0
while True:
    contacts = apis.phone.search_contacts(access_token=phone_token, query="friend", relationship="friend", page_index=page)
    if not contacts:
        break
    for c in contacts:
        friend_emails.add(c["email"])
    page += 1

venmo_token = apis.venmo.login(username=user.username, password=user.password)
for req in apis.venmo.show_received_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, status="pending"):
    if req.sender.email in friend_emails:
        apis.venmo.approve_payment_request(access_token=venmo_token, payment_request_id=req.payment_request_id)
apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=None, status="success")
